name: Deist Militia
body:
I may not look it, but I once seized sword and armor in defense of our land, new though it was to this benighted world.

Prerequisite(s): Landed human, may not have Simple Weapon Proficiency or Light Armor Proficiency

Benefit(s): The penalty for nonproficiency with weapons is halved (-2) and the penalty for nonproficiency with armor is reduced by 2.
